name: Weighted Recursive Least Squares (wRLS)
definition: A denoising method that adapts Recursive Least Squares (RLS) to handle heterogeneous noise in Volumetric Path Tracing (VPT) by assigning weights to samples based on their variance, reducing spike noise and maintaining temporal stability.
summary: Weighted Recursive Least Squares is a spatiotemporal denoising method for Volumetric Path Tracing that uses variance-based weighting and stable temporal features to reduce spike noise without relying on noisy G-buffers.
